item.title: Severe Thunderstorm Watch
item.description:
The risk of severe thunderstorms in Northland is easing and the Severe Thunderstorm Watch for Northland is lifted.
A moderate risk of severe thunderstorms with localised downpours (25 to 40 mm per hour) remains over Auckland, Great Barrier Island, Waikato, Coromandel Peninsula and Bay of Plenty west of Te Puke until early Wednesday morning. Note, the risk eases from the west tonight and early tomorrow morning.
Rainfall of this intensity can cause surface and/or flash flooding, especially about low-lying areas such as streams, rivers or narrow valleys, and may also lead to slips.
Driving conditions will also be hazardous with surface flooding and poor visibility in heavy rain.

item.title: Heavy Rain Watch
item.description: Periods of heavy rain with thunderstorms possible. Amounts may approach warning criteria. Chance of upgrading to a Warning: Moderate.

item.title: Heavy Rain Warning - Orange
item.description: Expect 100 to 130 mm of rain. Thunderstorms and localised downpours possible with rainfall intensities of 25 to 40 mm/h. Impact: Streams and rivers may rise rapidly. Surface flooding, slips, and difficult driving conditions possible. Chance of upgrading to a Red Warning: Minimal.
